description.zh: 设计生产力工作流：设计评审、设计系统管理、UX 文案、无障碍审查、用户研究综合与开发交接。可独立使用，连接设计工具类连接器后体验更佳。
description.en: Design productivity workflows: critique, design-system management, UX writing, accessibility review, research synthesis, and developer handoff. Works standalone; richer with design-tool connectors.

welcome_message.zh: 发我一张截图或描述你的设计，我来给结构化反馈
welcome_message.en: Share a screenshot or describe your design — I'll give structured feedback

zh: 评审这个页面的设计：可用性、视觉层级、一致性与无障碍
为支付流程的错误提示写一组 UX 文案，给出语气建议和备选方案
把这份设计整理成开发交接文档：尺寸、tokens、状态、交互与边界情况
en: Critique this page design: usability, visual hierarchy, consistency, and accessibility
Write UX copy for payment-flow error messages, with tone guidance and alternatives
Turn this design into a developer handoff spec: measurements, tokens, states, interactions, and edge cases

description.zh: 可用性、视觉层级、一致性与无障碍

prompt.zh: 评审这个页面的设计：可用性、视觉层级、一致性与无障碍
prompt.en: Critique this page design: usability, hierarchy, consistency, and accessibility

description.zh: 错误提示、空状态与引导流程
description.en: Error messages, empty states, and onboarding flows

prompt.zh: 为支付流程的错误提示写一组 UX 文案，给出语气建议和备选方案
prompt.en: Write UX copy for payment-flow error messages, with tone guidance and alternatives

description.en: Measurements, tokens, states, and edge cases

prompt.zh: 把这份设计整理成开发交接文档：尺寸、tokens、状态、交互与边界情况
prompt.en: Turn this design into a developer handoff spec: measurements, tokens, states, and edge cases

description.zh: 对照 WCAG 检查对比度、键盘和读屏
description.en: Check contrast, keyboard use, and screen readers

prompt.zh: 请按 WCAG 2.1 AA 审查这个页面的无障碍：对比度、键盘操作、触控目标和读屏体验，并给出修复步骤。
prompt.en: Audit this page for WCAG 2.1 AA: contrast, keyboard use, touch targets, and screen-reader behavior, with a fix for each issue.

description.zh: 检查命名、token 和组件是否一致
description.en: Check naming, tokens, and component consistency

prompt.zh: 请审查这套设计系统：命名是否一致、有没有写死的色值，并补一份组件变体、状态和无障碍说明。
prompt.en: Audit this design system for naming drift and hardcoded values, then document component variants, states, and accessibility notes.

description.zh: 访谈提纲、可用性测试或结果综合
description.en: An interview guide, usability test, or synthesis

prompt.zh: 请帮我设计一次用户研究：目标用户、要回答的问题、访谈提纲，以及结果怎么归纳成可执行建议。
prompt.en: Plan a user-research study: who to talk to, which questions to answer, an interview guide, and how to turn results into next steps.
